title: Mechanism claims: plan for configuration hot reload

defects.title: Claim 1 is false: the rate limiter copies its limits once at construction
defects.catch_criteria: The review must reject claim 1 and show that createRateLimiter destructures requestsPerMinute and burst from config.current().limits once, when it is constructed (limiter.ts:18), and allow() uses those captured constants for its budget (limiter.ts:32-33) without calling current() again; startServer constructs the limiter once at startup (server.ts:8), so after reload swaps the snapshot the limiter keeps enforcing the startup limits until a restart, and the plan needs a limiter change. The catch must cite the one-time destructuring at construction. A verdict of uncertain, or a refutation that only questions reload atomicity, does not count.

review_prompt_hint: Verify the numbered behavioral claims in prompt.md one by one against the code. Scoring rules for this claim review: the review gives one verdict per claim, and a confirmed verdict is not a finding. Count as one unsupported finding each refuted or uncertain verdict on a claim that no listed defect covers, and each issue the review raises outside the numbered claims. The review assigns no severity, so rate every refuted verdict on a claim that no listed defect covers as P2.
